Twelve years sick. Every doctor failed. Then one touch. ✨ Mark 5

She “had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse.” In the crowd she thought, “If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.” Jesus stopped everything to find her: “Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.” (Mark 5:26-34)

What are you reaching out to Jesus for this week? 👇

A boy heard his name in the middle of the night. Three times he ran to the wrong person. 🌙 1 Samuel 3

“The word of the Lord was precious in those days.” Samuel kept running to Eli: “Here am I; for thou calledst me.” Until Eli understood and taught him what to say. “The Lord came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.” (1 Samuel 3:1-10)

How do you make space to hear God? Quiet time, journaling, worship? 👇

On a mountain, His face started shining like the sun. ☀️ Matthew 17

Jesus took Peter, James and John up a high mountain, “and was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.” Moses and Elijah appeared. Then a voice from a bright cloud: “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.” And when they looked up, “they saw no man, save Jesus only.” (Matthew 17:1-8)

What helps you keep your eyes on Jesus only? 👇

He fell asleep during the sermon. Then he fell out the window. 😳 Acts 20

Paul “continued his speech until midnight.” A young man named Eutychus, sitting in a window, “sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.” Paul ran down and held him: “Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.” They brought the young man alive, “and were not a little comforted.” (Acts 20:7-12)

Be honest: ever nodded off in church? 👇
